references.name: Botanical atrium diorama
references.application: Retain the central island/tree silhouette and vertical garden/gallery hierarchy; add planted sitting pockets on existing terraces. The full court/canopy/water/inhabitation composition remains open.

references.name: Retained hull body sections
references.application: Continue the middle body shell into upper taper/headwall fields while holding occupied shoulders. Terminal body seams and source-owned roofs remain explicit interfaces.

references.name: Cruise atrium architecture benchmark
references.application: Use readable physical mullions, opal fixtures, framed roofs and sitting edges. Diagnostic source views are reviewed for geometry; benchmark-level lighting/material/final-art quality is unaccepted.

references.name: Whole ship blueprint
references.application: Preserve the long stepped body, retained crown and eighteen-deck hierarchy; avoid the rejected blanket roof and occupied roof/route voids.

limitations: First-pass common physical court kit on multiple terrace datums. Source snapshots retain exact geometry, but do not establish varied complete destination fit-out, full botanical ecosystem, load capacity or final benchmark quality.
